development_basis: P7-INTENSITY-001 and P7-ASSURE-001 exposed single-fragment string grounding failures

acceptance_criteria.inequality_threshold: represent issuer operator and threshold separately and evaluate deterministic result without converting the threshold into an exact reported value
acceptance_criteria.causal_epistemics: separate issuer attribution, textual support for attribution, and independent causal identification
acceptance_criteria.multi_fragment_projection: every fragment must be verbatim grounded to its own frozen evidence handle; composition is deterministic and preserves fragment provenance

prohibitions: no modification of P7 candidate output
no modification of P7 frozen simulated reference
no use of an unseen P8 source during development
